items.name: issue-table
items.title: Issue Table
items.description: The issues list: identifier, title with labels, status, priority, owner, executor and last update, with sorting and selection through callbacks. Use it for a list of issues. Presentational: map IssueListItem from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/issues to IssueTableRow.
items.docs: Map your issues (such as @nocobase/app-plugin-projects' IssueListItem) to IssueTableRow. Every word comes from the labels prop, English by default.

items.name: issue-card
items.title: Issue Card
items.description: One issue, compact: identifier, title, status in its workflow colour, priority, owner and executor (person or agent), due date and labels, as a one-line row for lists or a stacked card for boards; one link or button, with slots for marks and trailing actions, and a loading skeleton. Use it wherever an issue is listed outside a table. Presentational: map the issues of @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/issues to IssueCardIssue.
items.docs: Map your issues (such as @nocobase/app-plugin-projects' IssueListItem) to IssueCardIssue, as for issue-table, which it installs for its status badge, priority and person. Pass href (with link for a router link) or onSelect. Add the issueCard keys (priority.urgent, priority.high, priority.medium, priority.low, due, overdue, owner, executor, loading) to your locale resources, or pass labels.

items.name: issue-detail
items.title: Issue Detail
items.description: An issue's page as presentational parts: the two-column frame of cards on the page background, the header and description opening the body card, an add bar under it, the secondary parts (checklist, approvals, sub-issues, dependencies with an issue search, files) as sections sharing one heading pattern and hidden while empty, files dropped or pasted on the body, and the side column over property-fields. Use it for an issue detail page over the hooks of @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/issues.
items.docs: Compose the page from the parts: IssueDetailLayout pads the page and stacks cards in both columns. The body is one card (IssueSurface, or ISSUE_SURFACE on the IssueFileDrop around it) opened by the header and description; every part below is an IssueSection (heading row with icon, name, count and actions over its content, a thin divider between), so draw your own sections with IssueSection too. A part with nothing to show renders nothing: put the buttons that add its first item in IssueAddBar under the description (IssueAddButton, IssueFilesButton; IssueDependencies opens its search through adding/onAddingChange), and wrap the body in IssueFileDrop so dropped or pasted files upload. Lay the activity out with comment-thread in a second IssueSurface below the body. Every part takes data through props and performs changes through callbacks (promises it waits for); feed them from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/issues. Links go through the link renderer. Build IssueDetailLabels from your locale resources.

items.name: project-detail
items.title: Project Detail
items.description: A project's page as presentational parts: the header with progress, the overview's numbers, status distribution, description and members, the working directories (each linking to its settings page, with a row menu and an empty state), members and visibility settings, and the unreleased changes and previews. Use it for a project detail page over the hooks of @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/projects.
items.docs: Compose the page from the parts with your own tabs and sections between them; lay the properties out with property-fields. Every part takes data through props and performs changes through callbacks (promises it waits for); feed them from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/projects. Links go through the link renderer. Build ProjectDetailLabels from your locale resources.

items.name: plan-card
items.title: Plan Card
items.description: An operation plan of @nocobase/app-plugin-projects as a card: the issues it is about, its changes row by row with whom each wakes and what it risks, execute with a second confirmation for risky rows, void, check again, undo within the window after a preview, and an in-place editor of an open plan's rows over property-fields; a frame prop lays its parts out under a header of the caller's, such as an inbox detail pane's. Use it wherever an agent's or a status rule's plan is reviewed and decided, such as a chat timeline, an inbox or a plan page. Wired: reads and acts through the plugin's headless hooks in /client/kit and its pure plan rules in /client/plan-model.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-projects registered on the server and client, a router, and a QueryClientProvider with the application client's cache (which the plugin's plan announcements refresh) above the card. Render <PlanCard planId={id} /> from plan-card.tsx; it links the issues the plan is about under its title, firstIssueId (the issue it was opened from) first, and issueHref decides where each goes. Links go to the plugin's routes (/issues/plans/:id, /issues/:id, /projects/:id) unless the caller gives its own. Optionally provide PlanWordingContext from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects/client/kit to word plans another plugin proposed, and spread locales/ into client/locales/.
